footnotes.fn_2013f394: The reported figure is a preliminary estimate of persons of undetermined nationality by UNHCR. A previous estimate of 18,000 was revised, as UNHCR expects that more people in South Sudan will need help confirming their nationality in the future. Therefore, at the end of 2025, about 60,600 additional people are estimated to be at risk of statelessness and in need of support. These figures do not represent the number of stateless people, but rather those UNHCR expects to assist in confirming their nationality.
footnotes.fn_274931b2: The IDP figure differs from those agreed and communicated by UN OCHA, given the exlusion of IDPs due to disasters, in line with UNHCR methodology.
footnotes.fn_4a995f10: The reported figure is a preliminary estimate of persons of undetermined nationality by UNHCR. The estimate is based on the UNHCR 2018 statelessness study which documents specific profiles of groups at risk of statelessness in South Sudan.
footnotes.fn_8198401f: This newly reported figure is a preliminary estimate of persons of undetermined nationality by UNHCR. The estimate is based on the UNHCR 2018 statelessness study which documents specific profiles of groups at risk of statelessness in South Sudan.
footnotes.fn_b6146ffe: The reported figure is a preliminary estimate of persons of undetermined nationality by UNHCR. The start-year estimate is based on the UNHCR 2018 statelessness study which documents specific profiles of groups at risk of statelessness in South Sudan. During 2024, 19,561 people at risk of statelessness were assessed and issued nationality certificates. 27,411 additional people of undetermined nationality status were identified.
